tasks.label: Build active DCC C file for debugging
Stage debug data files
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/fixtures && find "${fileDirname}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.WTS' -o -name '*.IN' -o -name '*.DAT' \) -exec cp -f {} build/fixtures/ \;

tasks.label: Build and stage active DCC C file for debugging
dependsOn: Build active DCC C file for debugging

tasks.label: Build DCC debugger host
tasks.command: cmake -S src/dcc_debug_host -B build/dcc_debug_host && cmake --build build/dcc_debug_host --target dcc-debug-host

tasks.label: Prepare active DCC C file for debugging
dependsOn: Build and stage active DCC C file for debugging
